issue_context.title: Let Agg->DataSource be inner child of IndexJoin
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, Agg->DataSource cannot be inner child of IndexJoin. Here is an example.

```
mysql> create table ta(a int, b int, index idx_a(a));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.03 sec)

mysql> create table tb(a int, b int, index idx_a(a));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.02 sec)

mysql> explain select /*+ inl_join(t2@sel_2) */ t1.b,
    ->     (select count(t2.b) from tb t2 where t2.a = t1.a)
    -> from ta t1;
+------------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                                 | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                                                                               |
+------------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_11                      | 10000.00 | root      |               | test.ta.b, ifnull(Column#10, 0)->Column#10                                                  |
| └─HashJoin_13                      | 10000.00 | root      |               | left outer join, equal:[eq(test.ta.a, test.tb.a)]                                           |
|   ├─HashAgg_34(Build)              | 7992.00  | root      |               | group by:test.tb.a, funcs:count(Column#15)->Column#10, funcs:firstrow(test.tb.a)->test.tb.a |
|   │ └─TableReader_35               | 7992.00  | root      |               | data:HashAgg_27                                                                             |
|   │   └─HashAgg_27                 | 7992.00  | cop[tikv] |               | group by:test.tb.a, funcs:count(test.tb.b)->Column#15                                       |
|   │     └─Selection_33             | 9990.00  | cop[tikv] |               | not(isnull(test.tb.a))                                                                      |
|   │       └─TableFullScan_32       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                              |
|   └─TableReader_26(Probe)          | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_25                                                                       |
|     └─TableFullScan_25             | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                              |
+------------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
9 rows in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> show warnings;
+---------+------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                                                                                                                          |
+---------+------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1815 | There are no matching table names for (t2) in optimizer hint /*+ INL_JOIN(t2) */ or /*+ TIDB_INLJ(t2) */. Maybe you can use the table alias name |
+---------+------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
If both `ta` and `tb` are very large, HashJoin may consume too much memory and cause OOM. So we hope that IndexJoin can be used.

Here is the current logic rejecting Agg->DataSource as inner child of IndexJoin.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/430e75e04f726d11015100b0a751e3c51d27dc6c/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go#L669-L693
comments:
Using index join means the inner side has available indexes, which implies that the inner side should be a `DataSource`.
In this case, we need the optimizer not to decorrelate it. You can regard `Apply` and `IndexJoin` as having similar "probe" style execution strategies.

> Using index join means the inner side has available indexes, which implies that the inner side should be a `DataSource`. In this case, we need the optimizer not to decorrelate it. You can regard `Apply` and `IndexJoin` as having similar "probe" style execution strategies.

Yes, this way has a lower impl cost.

review_comments: Add the skip logic of mv index

Panic can be recovered by the outer layer, but if a problem occurs during the open process, it is not sure whether the children will be closed and whether to close the children.
But looking at the previous logic, it seems that close children are not handled

I think this method name can be improved.
1. It's too similar to the `constructInnerIndexScanTask` above.
2. This method is mostly about `Aggregate` but the name doesn't reflect this.
Why can we assume there is only one Agg in `zippedChildren` and its index must be `len(zippedChildren)-1`?
If there is an agg node at the bottom closest to the datasource, we need to consider whether it should be pushed down to tikv. If not, skip this part of the logic directly.
